overview.description: The Vanguard Morningstar Large-Cap ETF (VV) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Morningstar US Large Cap TR USD index. The fund seeks to track a market-cap-weighted portfolio that provides large-cap exposure to the US equity space. VV was launched on Jan 27, 2004 and is issued by Vanguard.
